description: Search global company registries by name across 140+ jurisdictions. Returns company name, jurisdiction, status, type, incorporation date, and registered address. REQUIRES your own OpenCorporates API token via _apiKey — their public API is closed and keyless calls return 401. For keyless global company lookup use gleif search_lei instead. Example: search_companies({query:"Tesla", country:"us", _apiKey:"..."})

_apiKey.description: Your OpenCorporates API token (required — get one at https://opencorporates.com/api_accounts/new)

name: search_companies
